text:
Jake Evans got hurt at practice, and Montreal can't easily replace what he's been doing. Sportsnet reported he's being evaluated; outlets have described it differently, so we'll wait for the Canadiens to say what it is. It comes with Nick Suzuki already out.

Evans had stepped up. His ice time over the last ten games was up more than three minutes, to almost 17 a night and close to 20 in two games, and Montreal had 57% of the five-on-five expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on the ice, seven points better than without him. Chris Kreider told Eric Engels of Sportsnet that "it's like he always makes the right play."

He has six points in 17 games, and his finishing is close to his chances (two goals on 2.6 expected). He's a seventh-round pick in 2014 who has played all 435 of his NHL games in Montreal. Our projection had him around 34 points; the injury will decide whether that number means anything.
